citations.quote: On infrastructure she is the person I would want on any Kubernetes or Terraform problem, and the drain controller was genuinely clever work.
Audited every deployment against 30-day p95 utilisation and corrected 180 pod specs.
Twelve services now provision through the shared modules with per-environment state.
The estate currently comprises 43 production services across 7 teams.

rationale: The evidence shows Kubernetes work (180 pod specs rightsized) and Terraform work (a shared module library with per-environment state, drift detection, and a drift reconciler) on a 43-service production estate, and a staff-engineer referee describes this as top-tier capability; the CKA certification lapsed in March 2024, but that does not conflict with the claim.
